qa_limits: All three are original modern comparisons,not identified Gospel boat/house/synagogue,museum copies or colour-based building dates. No historical/tool scope expanded.

Contact uses real opposite-facing coplanar polygon clipping and paired rays; AABBs only filter candidates.10um contact tolerance,20um oriented deep-surface probes,0.1um per-component weld.2mm keel side gap is a separate selected manufacturing clearance.
GLB sampled normal thickness shell19.9988–20.0000mm,frame29.9982–30.0000mm; minute differences reflect polygonal offset approximation,not enlarged tolerance.
Positive signed closed volume and consistent winding do not certify full-scale structural engineering,archaeological identity or mechanical loading.

All descendant vertices are tested for motion,fixed0 and restoration;20discrete BVH path samples and per-frame-vertex height-matched aperture checks do not constitute a continuous exhaustive collision sweep.
Static audit combines triangle overlaps and oriented nearest-surface vertex probes; it is a finite audit,not an exact symbolic Boolean proof.
At+.18m the entire U frame is detached with positive clearance; its bottom isY.305 belowY.450 rim. Full rib above rim requires lift>.325m; no second runtime operation added.

Recorded inspection hides expose actual undersides,inner floors and bearing faces. Those hide states and lifted display layers do not assert an ancient hatch,joinery mechanism or historical event replay.
